prerequisites: Background in Cryptographic primitives (encryption methods, signatures, MACs, hash functions)

learning_outcomes.text: classify and describe vulnerabilities and protection mechanisms of popular systems and protocols
analyze / reason about basic protection mechanisms for modern OSs, software, and hardware systems
reason about the security of a given protocol
independently develop appropriate security defenses and security models

syllabus_topics: Basic attack strategies on modern systems and platforms
Software-based defenses (e.g., address space randomization and non-executable memory)
Hardware-based defenses (e.g., using TPMs and TEEs)
Analyzing the security of modern cryptocurrencies
Analyzing the security of ML platforms
assessment_rules: The prerequisite for receiving credits is passing the written exam.
